spec.purpose: Improve net expectancy at unchanged account risk; preserve all failures; no real orders
spec.primary_hypothesis: Avoid expensive markets, stop entering stale trends, exit on regime deterioration and let winners trail instead of reopening them on a timer
spec.costs: 0.2% fee per side; frozen current spread proxy with 15bps round-trip floor; 1bp extra slippage each side; stress doubles spreads/slippage
spec.market_regime: Completed BTC 4h close above EMA50, EMA50 above EMA200, EMA20 rising over three completed bars
spec.retained_regime48: Original 7/28-day momentum plus market regime/spread filter; daily ATR stop; exit on regime loss or own hourly close below EMA200; retain eligible positions at 48h until hard 72h; no fixed profit cap
spec.trail4h72: At completed 4h closes: own close above EMA20 above EMA50 above EMA200; 24h return above round-trip cost and 7d return positive; select highest cost-adjusted 7d return/volatility; 2x 4h ATR stop, 3x 4h ATR trailing stop based on previously closed hourly prices; exit on BTC regime loss or own 4h close below EMA50; hard maximum 72h
spec.pullback4h72: Same as trail4h72, also require previous 4h low at or below EMA20 and current close recovering above previous close
spec.selection: Validation only: at least 10 trades; positive base AND stressed net P&L; observed drawdown below 2%; rank by stressed P&L then base P&L; baseline is a control, not a promotable variant
spec.integrity: Source/spec hashes frozen before development results. Record every variant. Previously uninspected earlier historical prices are an additional historical check, not prospective live evidence. July-Oct 2026 was already inspected in earlier work and cannot be presented as a new holdout. Present-day universe and spreads create historical selection assumptions.
